RideFlux Registers 100th Patent for LiDAR-to-Lane-and-Curb Map Conversion Technology

📅 2026-08-12 ✍️ VentureSquare 🏷️ RideFlux, LiDAR, autonomous driving, high-precision mapping, lane mapping, curb mapping, HD maps, patent, Level 4 autonomy, South Korea
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

South Korean autonomous driving company RideFlux has registered its 100th patent for technology that automatically converts real-time LiDAR data into high-precision maps displaying lanes and curbs, reducing HD map production costs and time.

📌 Key takeaways

  • 100th patent covers automatic conversion of LiDAR data into lane and curb maps for autonomous vehicles
  • Technology automates the previously manual labeling process for high-precision map production
  • Patent received AAA rating on Korea Invention Promotion Association's SMART5 evaluation system
  • RideFlux has 148 patent applications and 100 registrations with a 95.06% registration rate
  • Patent filing efficiency of 16.78 applications per 10 billion won invested, ~13x higher than Waymo's 1.32
  • Company conducting unmanned Level 4 autonomous driving test runs in Korea, plans KOSDAQ listing
